[8 marks] A practical problem in Mathematics-III requires the behaviour or method described by for equally likely outcomes, favourable outcomes are divided by the total outcomes. Explain how Classical probability applies, outline the main steps and justify the result.

[8 marks] A practical problem in Mathematics-III requires the behaviour or method described by a power of a sum is expanded using binomial coefficients and powers of the terms. Explain how Binomial theorem (without proof) for positive integral index (expansion and general form applies, outline the main steps and justify the result.
